lines.japanese: いや、ちょっと待ってください監督。
lines.english: No, wait just a moment, Director.

lines.japanese: だって、ねえ？　よくよく考えてみれば、相手は俺と同年代ながられっきとした社会人でしょう？
lines.english: Think about it, won't you? She may be about my age, but she's a bona fide working adult.

lines.japanese: となれば、休み時間の教室や飲み屋の座敷向けなアーパー文脈で接するわけにもいきません。こちらとしても相応の節度を示さなければ礼を失します。
lines.english: That being so, I could hardly treat her to the sort of brainless banter fit for a classroom between lessons or a table at a bar. Common courtesy demanded a corresponding degree of restraint from me.

lines.japanese: たとえ先方がわりかしファンキーめなお人柄であろうとも、やはりここは一般的な社会通念に基づいて、ごくごく無難な会話から進めていくのが、ひととしての正しい筋書きではないでしょうか。
lines.english: Even if the lady herself happens to be on the funkier side, surely the proper course for one human being is to proceed from the safest and most conventional of topics, in keeping with society's ordinary standards.

lines.japanese: という思惑を端的かつ迅速に監督へ伝えるため、俺は顔の右半分を下へ、左半分を上へしかめるという混沌の表情を作ってみせました。
lines.english: To communicate this reasoning to the Director with maximum speed and economy, I contorted the right half of my face downward and the left half upward into an expression of pure chaos.

lines.japanese: しかしそんな臆病者の俺を見て、かの管制塔は柄にもなく大きな動作で、激しい失意の念を表しました。
lines.english: At the sight of cowardly me, however, the control tower expressed his bitter disappointment with uncharacteristically sweeping gestures.

lines.japanese: 両方の手の平を上にむけ、ひょいっと肩をすくませるその仕草は「もうお前にはがっかりだよ」。
lines.english: Both palms turned upward, shoulders lifted in a quick shrug: ‘I'm disappointed in you.’

lines.japanese: 続けて眉間に人差し指と中指を当て、その肘をもう片方の手で支える姿は「ヨネも悲しむだろうな」。
lines.english: Then he pressed two fingers to his brow, propping that elbow up with his other hand: 'Yone's gonna be real sad.'

lines.japanese: そしてとどめと言わんばかりに、首を左右に振りながらわかりやすぅ～いため息一つ「呆れてものも言えねえよ」。
lines.english: Then came the finishing blow: he shook his head and let out one big, painfully obvious sigh. 'Man, I got no words for you.'

lines.japanese: 分かります、ええ、あなたのおっしゃりたいことは十分に分かりますとも。
lines.english: I understand. Oh yes, I understand exactly what you're trying to say. Believe me.

lines.japanese: あの『可愛らしさに欠けるくん』とさえ呼ばれる鳳さん家のカケルくんが、そんなお歌のおにいさんみたいなオーバーリアクションを披露してまで俺の世話を焼いてくれている──
lines.english: Kakeru Ohtori—Kakeru the Uncuddly, of all people—was going out of his way to help me with the broad pantomime of a children’s TV singalong host—

lines.japanese: ──それはとても有りがたいことなのですが、しかし理性という名の羞恥心が俺に精神的バンジージャンプを踏みきらせてくれないのです。
lines.english: —and deeply grateful though I was, the sense of shame known as reason refused to let me take that mental bungee jump.

lines.japanese: もはやこれが最後の頼み。俺は顔全体を下に歪めました。この表情こそ偽らぬ意思とばかり、無言で監督に泣きつきました。
lines.english: This was my last appeal. I dragged my entire face downward and silently implored the Director to accept that expression as my one honest declaration of intent.

lines.japanese: しかし醜くすぼまった我が目に映るは、さながら俺の肩にぽんと手を置くがごときカケルくんの満面の微笑みでした。
lines.english: Yet through my ugly, scrunched-up eyes, I saw Kakeru's radiant smile, as reassuring as a hand laid upon my shoulder.

lines.japanese: くっ、くそう……ここまで発破をかけられては、ダニ並みの心臓を持つ俺と言えど、ワニ並みの獰猛さで応えなければなりません。
lines.english: D-damn it... With him firing me up this fiercely, even a man with the heart of a mite would have to answer with the ferocity of a crocodile.

lines.japanese: 覚悟を決めた俺は、心の崖の前、心の腰に心の縄をくくりつけました。
lines.english: My resolve firm, I stood before the cliff of my heart and tied the rope of my heart around the waist of my heart.
